svg.title: BSController internal architecture
svg.desc: A detailed view of one Controller. HCI framing and command dispatch submit decoded operations to LinkLayerService and AdvertisingService. RadioLink owns active role contexts, connections, and the shared radio resource manager. Each connection has a lifetime context, an LLCP coordinator with control, encryption and data-length procedures, and a connection-event executor that owns ARQ, the transmit queue and retry state. ACL data enters the executor through the LL service. Connectionless role executors and connection events share radio reservations and a BabbleSim radio adapter. Typed Listener callbacks return results to HCI event adaptation. Runtime composes the objects, drives LL time, gates PHY requests and manages the external PHY process.
